svg.title: Cell dish
svg.desc: Top-view cell-culture dish with lid rim, pink medium, adherent cell islands, and a liquid meniscus. Biological basis: Adherent cultured cells spread across the treated plastic surface beneath a shallow layer of buffered culture medium.
